key_insight: The paper builds the first large spin-polarized electronic-structure and bonding database for stable Cs2BB'X6 halide double perovskites, revealing broad tunability in band structure, magnetism, and chemical bonding.
engineering_relevance: This dataset helps screen perovskites for photovoltaics, photocatalysis, and radiation detection by identifying compositions with visible-range gaps, half-metallicity, and favorable orbital interactions.
method: Hybrid-functional DFT calculated DOS for >2,500 stable Cs2BB'X6 compounds
Applied spin-polarized electronic-structure analysis across X = I, Br, Cl, F
Used LOBSTER for chemical-bonding analysis and UMAP for interactive exploration
evidence_signal: The abstract reports >2,500 compounds in the database, with 719 visible-range band gaps and 118 half-metallic materials.
watch_item: Results are computational and stability-filtered, so experimental synthesis, defects, and temperature-dependent behavior may alter real-device performance.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
